# Pull requests use the bounded PR profile; main/manual runs retain full release evidence.
# Tests enforce <20 PR jobs, four AOT shards (two elsewhere), and <=15 min/job.
# Consumers reuse a same-run verified bootstrap; runtime caches remain private.
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.sha || github.ref) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PYSTACHY_JOBS: '4'
  CI_EVENT_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || '' }}
  CI_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || '' }}

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    name: verify (bootstrap, ${{ matrix.machine }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.machine == 'aarch64' && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    # Each matrix row publishes a distinct output so the aggregate can check agreement.
    outputs:
      plan_x86_64: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan_x86_64 }}
      plan_aarch64: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan_aarch64 }}
      # PRs build x86 only; full runs independently build both Linux architectures.
      base: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.base }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        machine: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["x86_64"]' || '["x86_64","aarch64"]') }}
    env:
      PYSTACHY_LLVM: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Select documentation or code verification
        id: plan
        env:
          CI_MACHINE: ${{ matrix.machine }}
        run: |
          plan=$(python3 tools/ci_gate.py plan "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" "$CI_EVENT_BASE_SHA" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$CI_HEAD_SHA")
          base=
          if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ]; then base=$(git rev-parse HEAD^1); fi
          printf 'kind=%s\nplan_%s=%s\n' "$plan" "$CI_MACHINE" "$plan" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'base=%s\n' "$base" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'Verification plan: %s\n' "$plan"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
      - name: LLVM toolchain
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        run: tools/setup.sh --minimal
      - name: Record native Linux ABI
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        env:
          VERIFY_MACHINE: ${{ matrix.machine }}
        run: |
          test "$(uname -m)" = "$VERIFY_MACHINE"
          getconf PAGESIZE
          getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION
      - name: Verify compiler and runtime fixed points
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        run: tests/verify.sh bootstrap
      - name: Package verified bootstrap
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        run: python3 tools/verification_bootstrap.py export build/ci-bootstrap
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        if: steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code'
        with:
          name: verified-bootstrap-${{ matrix.machine }}
          path: build/ci-bootstrap/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true  # allow a producer rerun; consumers still validate this run and commit
      - name: Upload bootstrap report
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.plan.outputs.kind == 'code' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.machine }}-verification-bootstrap
          path: |
            build/verification.json
            build/verify/bootstrap.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  verification:
    name: verify (${{ matrix.group }}, ${{ matrix.machine }})
    needs: bootstrap
    if: needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_x86_64 == 'code' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_aarch64 == 'code')
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.machine == 'aarch64' && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    # Target <10 minutes of work per group; retain headroom for runner variation
    # and failure diagnostics. GC self-compilation has its own 10-minute bound.
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        machine: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["x86_64"]' || '["x86_64","aarch64"]') }}
        group: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["hosted","native-aot-0","native-aot-1","native-aot-2","native-aot-3","safety-0","safety-1","opt-in","contracts","cache-gc","benchmarks"]' || '["hosted","native-0","native-1","native-2","opt-off-0","opt-off-1","opt-off-2","python-free-0","python-free-1","python-free-2","python-free-3","ubsan-0","ubsan-1","ubsan-2","ubsan-3","ubsan-4","gc-self","gc-ir-0","gc-ir-1","gc-jit-0","gc-jit-1","gc-aot-0","gc-aot-1","gc-aot-2","runtime-cache","dynany-optin-0","dynany-optin-1","dynany-optin-2","python-int-optin-0","python-int-optin-1","python-int-optin-2","contracts","benchmarks","scaling"]') }}
    env:
      VERIFY_PROFILE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'pr' || 'full' }}
      PYSTACHY_LLVM: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin
      CI_BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.bootstrap.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: tools/requirements-dev.txt

      - name: LLVM 18 toolchain
        env:
          VERIFY_GROUP: ${{ matrix.group }}
        # Only the sanitizer and BLAS jobs need the extra verification packages.
        # New groups keep the full setup until their dependencies have been checked.
        run: |
          case "$VERIFY_GROUP" in
            hosted|native-[012]|native-aot-[0123]|opt-off-[012]|python-free-[0123]|gc-self|gc-ir-[01]|gc-jit-[01]|gc-aot-[012]|runtime-cache|dynany-optin-[012]|python-int-optin-[012]|contracts|scaling|safety-0|opt-in|cache-gc)
              tools/setup.sh --minimal ;;
            *) tools/setup.sh --verify ;;
          esac

      - name: Opt-in, widening and Lean corpus CPython dependency
        if: startsWith(matrix.group, 'dynany-optin-') || startsWith(matrix.group, 'python-int-optin-') || matrix.group == 'opt-in' || matrix.group == 'runtime-cache' || (matrix.group == 'gc-jit-1' && matrix.machine == 'x86_64')
        run: python3 -m pip install "$(sed -n '/^typing_extensions==/p' tools/requirements-dev.txt)"

      - name: Workload pytest oracle dependency
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks' || ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'opt-in') || (github.event_name != 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'hosted'))
        run: python3 -m pip install "$(sed -n '/^pytest==/p' tools/requirements-dev.txt)"

      # No run-id or token: download-artifact can only select this workflow run here.
      - name: Download verified bootstrap
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333  # v8
        with:
          name: verified-bootstrap-${{ matrix.machine }}
          path: build/ci-bootstrap

      - name: Verify group
        env:
          VERIFY_GROUP: ${{ matrix.group }}
          VERIFY_BOOTSTRAP_DIR: build/ci-bootstrap
        run: tests/verify.sh "$VERIFY_GROUP"

      # These hosted/native controls run sequentially after a short GC JIT group.
      # PRs use the second native JIT worker below; neither placement adds a job.
      - name: Runtime ABI and GC root checker controls
        if: matrix.group == 'gc-jit-0' && matrix.machine == 'x86_64'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libclang-rt-18-dev
          # Generated-code ASan controls run in x86 gc-jit-0 (full) or safety-1 (PRs).
          PYSTACHY_CACHE_TEST_LLVM="$PYSTACHY_LLVM" python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.TestSuite(
              unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tools", pattern=path.name)
              for path in sorted(Path("tools").glob("test_runtime_*.py"))
              if path.name != "test_runtime_asan.py"
          )
          raise SystemExit(not unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite).wasSuccessful())
          PY
          PY=python3 CC="$PYSTACHY_LLVM/clang" ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 \
            tools/check_cpu_buffers.sh '-fsanitize=address,undefined'
          PY=python3 CC="$PYSTACHY_LLVM/clang" ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 \
            tools/check_cpu_buffers.sh --negative-control '-fsanitize=address,undefined'

      # Exhaustive Lean corpora stay in full verification; every PR retains the kernel,
      # checker negative controls and bounded union/null proofs in contracts and Lint.
      # Each proof command uses two local processes and finishes before the next begins.
      # The pinned release archive is for x86_64 Linux.
      - name: Cache the pinned Lean release archive
        if: matrix.machine == 'x86_64' && (matrix.group == 'gc-jit-1' || matrix.group == 'scaling' || matrix.group == 'contracts')
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9  # v6.1.0
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pystachy/lean
          key: lean-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-7289597a44543246c9227b8cae501767e095ce17f6d448b95fc4a8dc97268f6d

      - name: Lean proofs of compiler guard obligations
        if: matrix.machine == 'x86_64' && (matrix.group == 'gc-jit-1' || matrix.group == 'scaling' || matrix.group == 'contracts')
        env:
          VERIFY_GROUP: ${{ matrix.group }}
        run: |
          lean_boundary_dir=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$lean_boundary_dir"' EXIT
          lean_bin=$(python3 tools/setup_lean.py --output "$lean_boundary_dir")
          case "$VERIFY_GROUP" in
            gc-jit-1)
              PATH="$lean_bin:$PATH" \
                make check-lean-corpus LEAN_CORPUS_FLAGS='--jobs 2 --report build/verify/lean-corpus.json'
              PATH="$lean_bin:$PATH" \
                make check-lean-int LEAN_INT_FLAGS='--jobs 2 --report build/verify/lean-int.json' ;;
          esac
          case "$VERIFY_GROUP" in
            contracts)
              PATH="$lean_bin:$PATH" \
                make check-lean-guards LEAN_GUARD_FLAGS='--jobs 2 --report build/verify/lean-guards.json tools/lean_boundary/examples/null_guards.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/null_reloads.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/union_effects.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/union_guards.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/union_split.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/union_memory.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/union_defaults.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/gc_arrays.py tools/lean_boundary/examples/field_init.py' ;;
          esac
          case "$VERIFY_GROUP" in
            scaling)
              PATH="$lean_bin:$PATH" \
                make check-lean-storage LEAN_STORAGE_FLAGS='--jobs 2 --report build/verify/lean-storage.json' ;;
          esac

      - name: Require C, embedding and extension FFI coverage
        if: matrix.group == 'contracts'
        run: |
          test -s build/verify/ffi.log
          if grep -Fq '; skipped:' build/verify/ffi.log; then
            cat build/verify/ffi.log
            echo 'Native Linux verification requires every advertised FFI mode' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Native thread stack-size edge cases, the native stack's floor and ABI controls
        if: matrix.group == 'contracts'
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_runtime_thread.py
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_stack_floor.py
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_runtime_signatures.py

      # PRs use the short safety worker; full runs use the existing x86 GC JIT worker.
      # setup.sh already validates LLVM; compiler-rt supplies the runtime and preload library.
      - name: Generated user and runtime ASan controls
        if: matrix.machine == 'x86_64' && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'safety-1') || (github.event_name != 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'gc-jit-0'))
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libclang-rt-18-dev
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_runtime_asan.py -v

      - name: Sanitized shared and object JIT linkage controls
        if: matrix.group == 'ubsan-0' || matrix.group == 'safety-1'
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_runtime_ubsan.py

      - name: Native program cache invalidation and execution
        # Full runs keep this independent probe on both architectures' runtime-cache jobs.
        # Pull requests run it in the first native JIT worker (pr-variants), the shortest job.
        if: matrix.group == 'runtime-cache'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make test-program-cache PROGRAM_CACHE_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Extended subset benchmark correctness
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make bench-extended-check BENCH_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Adapted pyperformance benchmark correctness
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make bench-pyperformance-check BENCH_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Bounded match dispatch correctness
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make bench-match-check BENCH_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Shared pytest example assertions
        if: ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'opt-in') || (github.event_name != 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'hosted'))
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make test-pytest-workloads PYTEST_WORKLOAD_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2 PYTEST_WORKLOAD_ARGS='--group examples'

      # Retain the hosted compiler and original pytest oracle without using Lint's budget.
      - name: Generated native pytest runner parity
        if: matrix.machine == 'x86_64' && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'opt-in') || (github.event_name != 'pull_request' && matrix.group == 'hosted'))
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make test-pytest-native PYTEST_NATIVE_COMPILER="$PWD/build/verify/pystachy2"

      # tools/setup.sh installs both of Ubuntu's LP64 libblas.so.3 providers: OpenBLAS
      # (libopenblas0-pthread), checked on one thread, and the reference BLAS (libblas3).
      # LD_LIBRARY_PATH selects each in turn; NumPy is check_blas.py's reference
      - name: Optional BLAS adapter and nanoGPT fused-linear correctness
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
          BLAS_MACHINE: ${{ matrix.machine }}
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install numpy==2.5.4
          OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/"$BLAS_MACHINE"-linux-gnu/openblas-pthread \
            make blas-check BENCH_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2
          LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/"$BLAS_MACHINE"-linux-gnu/blas make blas-check BENCH_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Upstream large regex (JIT and AOT, normal GC)
        if: matrix.group == 'benchmarks'
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make port-check-large PORT_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2

      - name: Upload group report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.machine }}-verification-${{ matrix.group }}
          path: |
            build/pyperformance-smoke.json
            build/match-dispatch-smoke.json
            build/pytest-pyperformance.json
            build/pytest-workloads.json
            build/pytest-native/examples.json
            build/pytest-native-aot/examples.json
            build/pytest-controls.json
            build/pytest-upstream-bundled.json
            build/verification.json
            build/extended-smoke.json
            build/program-cache-checks.json
            build/verify/*.log
            build/verify/example-cli.json
            build/verify/dynany-fuzz/*.py
            build/verify/dynany-optin-*.json
            build/verify/lean-corpus.json
            build/verify/lean-int.json
            build/verify/lean-storage.json
            build/verify/lean-guards.json
            build/verify/dynany-optin-*/tests/programs/*/*
            build/verify/python-int-optin-*.json
            build/verify/python-int-optin-*/tests/programs/*/*
            build/verify/python-int-optin-*/evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  pr-variants:
    name: native JIT and variants (worker ${{ matrix.worker }})
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_x86_64 == 'code'
    needs: bootstrap
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        worker: [0, 1]
    env:
      VERIFY_PROFILE: pr
      PYSTACHY_LLVM: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin
      CI_BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.bootstrap.outputs.base }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
      - run: tools/setup.sh --minimal
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333  # v8
        with:
          name: verified-bootstrap-x86_64
          path: build/ci-bootstrap
      # Two JIT halves finish before the existing sparse configurations. Four separate
      # AOT shards reduce the measured 13.5-minute compilation load per worker.
      - name: Complete native JIT corpus half
        env:
          VARIANT_WORKER: ${{ matrix.worker }}
          VERIFY_BOOTSTRAP_DIR: build/ci-bootstrap
        run: tests/verify.sh "native-jit-$VARIANT_WORKER"
      - name: Upload native JIT report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: x86_64-verification-native-jit-${{ matrix.worker }}
          path: |
            build/verification.json
            build/verify/*.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true
      - name: Sampled configurations on representative and changed cases
        env:
          VARIANT_WORKER: ${{ matrix.worker }}
          VERIFY_BOOTSTRAP_DIR: build/ci-bootstrap
        run: python3 tools/pr_variants.py --worker "$VARIANT_WORKER"
      # Keep program-cache and runtime controls in the JIT workers, after their corpus
      # halves and variants, using the restored compiler and independent runtime caches.
      - name: Native program cache invalidation and execution
        if: matrix.worker == 0
        env:
          PYSTACHY_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: make test-program-cache PROGRAM_CACHE_COMPILER=build/verify/pystachy2
      - name: Runtime ABI and GC root checker controls
        if: matrix.worker == 1
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libclang-rt-18-dev
          # Generated-code ASan controls run in x86 gc-jit-0 (full) or safety-1 (PRs).
          PYSTACHY_CACHE_TEST_LLVM="$PYSTACHY_LLVM" python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.TestSuite(
              unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tools", pattern=path.name)
              for path in sorted(Path("tools").glob("test_runtime_*.py"))
              if path.name != "test_runtime_asan.py"
          )
          raise SystemExit(not unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite).wasSuccessful())
          PY
          PY=python3 CC="$PYSTACHY_LLVM/clang" ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 \
            tools/check_cpu_buffers.sh '-fsanitize=address,undefined'
          PY=python3 CC="$PYSTACHY_LLVM/clang" ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 \
            tools/check_cpu_buffers.sh --negative-control '-fsanitize=address,undefined'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pr-variants-${{ matrix.worker }}
          path: |
            build/variants
            build/program-cache-checks.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  qualification:
    name: Bootstrap tier and native archive qualification
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: bootstrap
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      PYSTACHY_LLVM: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
      - run: tools/setup.sh --minimal
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333  # v8
        with:
          name: verified-bootstrap-x86_64
          path: build/ci-bootstrap
      - name: Restore the verified producer and its report
        run: |
          python3 tools/verification_bootstrap.py restore build/ci-bootstrap
          cp build/ci-bootstrap/verification.json build/verification.json
      - name: Compare O1 temporary compiler with verified O2 bootstrap
        run: python3 tools/check_bootstrap_tier.py build/ci-bootstrap
      - name: Native release archive smoke
        run: |
          cp build/verify/pystachy2 pystachy
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_release*.py'
          release_version=$(cat VERSION)
          python3 tools/release_notes.py check "docs/releases/$release_version.md"
          python3 tools/release.py --version "$release_version" --target linux-x86_64 --output-dir build/release-smoke
          python3 tools/release_smoke.py "build/release-smoke/pystachy-$release_version-linux-x86_64.tar.gz"
      - name: Upload qualification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: bootstrap-tier-and-archive
          path: |
            build/bootstrap-tier/report.json
            build/bootstrap-tier/make.log
            build/release-smoke/*.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  verify:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'Verification' || format('make verify (Linux {0}, LLVM 18, Python 3.13)', matrix.machine == 'aarch64' && 'ARM64' || 'x86-64') }}
    # Report dependency failures, but release the PR concurrency slot on cancellation.
    # always() keeps obsolete summary jobs queued and blocks the replacement run.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs: [bootstrap, verification, pr-variants, qualification]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      CI_BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.bootstrap.outputs.base }}
    # Artifact downloads alone have exceeded three minutes on otherwise green runs.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        machine: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["x86_64"]' || '["x86_64","aarch64"]') }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0  # v7.1.0
        if: needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_x86_64 == 'code' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_aarch64 == 'code')
        with:

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333  # v8
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_x86_64 == 'code' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || needs.bootstrap.outputs.plan_aarch64 == 'code') }}

#!/bin/sh
# Verification harness: every check below runs (a failing step does not stop the others) and the
# results go to build/verification.json -- per step: name, pass/fail, duration, counts -- with the
# toolchain versions, git commit and a timestamp. Exit status 0 only if every step passed.
#   bootstrap      CPython -> stage1 -> stage2 -> stage3 compilers emit identical LLVM IR
#   tests-cpython  the CPython-hosted compiler against stage 2 on every case of the corpus
#                  (tools/irsame.sh): the same IR (`ir`, `rt` for rtmode_*), messages and exit status,
#                  byte for byte, and the same `check` output and status for each syntax_*.py, so that
#                  tests-native's JIT and AOT runs execute exactly what it compiles; a sample (shard 0
#                  of HOSTED_SAMPLE_OF, a program of each hosted_strata kind) runs end to end too, JIT
#                  and AOT
#   tests-native-0/-1/-2 tests/run.sh with the stage-2 native compiler, JIT and AOT, each on one of
#                  three disjoint thirds of the corpus (shard_cases)
#   tests-opt-off-0/-1/-2 tests/run.sh with the stage-2 compiler and every optimization on the IR
#                  turned off (PYSTACHY_OPT=-all), each on one of three disjoint thirds of the corpus
#                  (shard_cases): the passes change no output
#   runtime-cache  tests/cache.sh with both compilers: the cached runtime is used while nothing it is
#                  built from changes, built again when runtime.c, a file it includes from ryu/ or mpz/,
#                  runtime.py, the compiler or a tool changes (also by a same-size edit whose mtime is
#                  set back, or one made while it is built), keyed by the flags too, never left by a
#                  failed build; ext's glue cached beside it; a run's own runtime while a tool is not
#                  settled; PATH's rules
#   python-free-0/-1/-2/-3 PATH holds only symlinks to the LLVM tools, the linker and the POSIX tools
#                  that the driver and tests/run.sh call (no python3): the native compiler rebuilds
#                  its runtime and itself, reproduces the same IR and passes the tests of the shard's
#                  quarter of the corpus
#   ubsan-0/-1/-2/-3/-4 PYSTACHY_CFLAGS="$UBSAN" (private PYSTACHY_HOME, so a fresh runtime cache): the
#                  compiler built that way reproduces the IR, and every test of the shard's fifth of the
#                  corpus passes AOT-built with it and JIT-run on the sanitized runtime (lli gets the
#                  UBSan runtime via LD_PRELOAD)
#   check-ir       tools/check_ir.sh: the compiler's IR check (PYSTACHY_IRCHECK=1) and llvm-as accept the
#                  IR of every program of the corpus (the tests, the benchmarks, the tests/ir probes and
#                  the compiler itself) and of runtime.py
#   runtime-table  tools/check_runtime.py: the compiler's RUNTIME table agrees with runtime.c and
#                  runtime.py (types, coverage, and the effects their call graphs show), and no
#                  function of runtime.py reaches itself through runtime.c
#   gc-self        the native compiler collecting every 5000 allocations reproduces the IR
#   gc-ir-0/-1     the stage-2 compiler collecting every 1000 allocations compiles each case of one of
#                  two disjoint halves of the corpus (gc_shard_cases), and runtime.py, exactly as stage 2
#                  does unstressed (tools/irsame.sh: the same IR, messages and exit status, byte for
#                  byte), and `check`s each syntax_*.py alike (tools/irsame.sh --check)
#   gc-jit-0/-1, gc-aot-0/-1/-2 every test of the shard passes, JIT (two halves) or AOT (three
#                  thirds), with a collection at every program allocation (PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM=1);
#                  one case in GC_SAMPLE_EVERY of the shard, heaviest first (from an offset of each
#                  mode's), runs with the compiler collecting every 1000 too (first, so it builds the
#                  runtime the step's tests use), the shard's other cases compiled by stage 2
#                  unstressed, whose IR gc-ir shows to be the stressed compiler's
#   benchmarks     bench/*.py print exactly what CPython prints, JIT and AOT; timings recorded
#   example-cli    real example command lines match CPython's status/stdout/stderr, JIT and AOT;
#                  existing JSON repair process cases and agent loopback-HTTP checks also pass, and
#                  the recorded JSON repair corpus replays natively, JIT and AOT
#   rtcheck        tools/rtcheck.py: runtime.py, run by CPython, gives what CPython's str methods and
#                  math functions give on random inputs
#   re-fuzz        tools/re_fuzz.py: lib/re, run by CPython, compiles random patterns to the code and
#                  errors CPython's re does and matches, splits and substitutes as it does, on CPython's
#                  strs and on Pystachy's UTF-8 ones, and so do test_re's cases too big for gc-stress
#   dynany-fuzz    tools/dynany_fuzz.py: 3 seeded programs, each with 150 random + 30 typed/Any
#                  parity cases; JIT/AOT, normal and program GC-stressed (sources kept on failure)
#   annotation-widening  CPython-qualified concrete/Any source pairs, both native modes and focused program GC
#   dynany-optin-0/-1/-2 tests/programs corpus with dynamic Any enabled, fresh CPython
#                  oracle and JIT/AOT; three disjoint shards, exact reviewed exceptions only
#   python-int-optin-0/-1/-2 tests/programs corpus with promoting ints enabled, fresh
#                  CPython oracle and JIT/AOT; three disjoint shards, reviewed exceptions only
#   re-probe       tools/re_probe.py: lib/re, run by CPython, enters its matcher and makes contexts no
#                  more often than fixed limits allow for textwrap's patterns (deterministic counts),
#                  with the results of CPython's re
#   rt-abi         tools/rtabi.py: each function runtime.py defines or declares has the same LLVM
#                  signature in runtime.py, runtime.c and every program of the corpus
#   inherited-ast tools/inheritprobe.py: unused inherited methods retain linear AST storage, and
#                  comparisons of a base's values compile to IR linear in its subclasses
#   streaming      tools/streamprobe.py: sum(), min() and max() of range() and of generator expressions
#                  take the items as they come: 100,000,000 of them in 64 MiB, AOT
#   ffi            tests/ffi/run.sh with the stage-2 compiler: @ffi.extern's C calls and the FFI's
#                  compile-time errors, then, with $PY's libpython, lib/pyobj.py embedding CPython and
#                  pystachy ext's extension modules, against the twins in tools/rt_cpython (docs/ffi.md)
#   list-storage   tools/listprobe.c: cleared reachable lists release backing capacity and live bytes;
#                  empty operations/reuse preserve sort's sentinel, without allocation in clear;
#                  dropped pointer-free large arrays, when most of what is allocated, run
#                  collections every max(4 MiB, live bytes) of them; small objects and arrays
#                  of pointers keep the 32 MiB window
#   container-eq   tools/eqprobe.c: shared DAG comparisons stop within a fixed comparison budget,
#                  including ordering and list searches; a str's == and searches of int, bool
#                  and str lists run no generic comparison; normally and with GC stress
#   weakrefs       tools/weakrefprobe.c: true weak targets and dead registry entries are cleared
#                  before sweeping, including cycles, large objects and allocation stress
#   box-slots      tools/boxprobe.c: Any and union boxes take exact 16-byte slots of the right kind;
#                  a pointer to a box's payload keeps it, one past its end does not, with GC stress too
#   file-buffers   tools/fileprobe.c: writable files' malloc'd buffers count as heap bytes, so files
#                  dropped without close() run collections; every close takes back exactly what was
#                  counted, a standard stream's are never counted (deterministic counts, no RSS)
#   select-io      tools/selectprobe.c: real pipe readiness, duplicate descriptors, EOF and EINTR
#                  timeout-deadline/blocking retries, normally and with GC stress
#   dict-probes    tools/dictprobe.c: dict lookups visit few table slots for keys that defeat a weak
#                  hash or probe sequence (deterministic counts against a fixed limit, no timings);
#                  the collector scans the key tables of strs and tuples, and none of ints;
#                  only dfindc, the probe of CPython-hashed tables, tests entries for a key
#                  past 64 bits: not dfinds (str keys), dfindi (native int keys, which
#                  compares no strs) or dfind's generic probe
#   compile-limits tools/compilelimits.py: hosted/native ir/run/build reject growing types,
#                  specialization breadth and the signature bytes specializations retain under
#                  256 MiB / ten CPU seconds, with short diagnostics;
#                  finite controls and reuse at the retained-instance boundary still compile
#   jit-dead-code  tools/jitprobe.py: unused functions never reach the JIT runner (lljit.c) or lli,
#                  and a small helper reaches them inlined (not with PYSTACHY_JIT_INLINE=0); live code
#                  and runtime callbacks still execute as in CPython, with both compilers, both
#                  runners and both levels of code generation; jitfdprobe.py preserves inherited
#                  pipes, CPython's descriptor tables and SIGINT dispositions across both runners,
#                  shared/object runtime, -O0 code generation, embedding, cached and AOT launches;
#                  tools/test_lljit.py: the runner is built and cached once, falls back to lli where
#                  it cannot be, and keeps lli's contract on small C programs
#   aot-dead-code  tools/aotprobe.py: an AOT build links the precompiled runtime specialized
#                  for pys_plain; a program that opts in to neither dynamic Any nor promoting ints
#                  keeps none of their runtime helpers, and its list stores none of their companion
#                  code; direct and imported opt-ins retain them; objects that never escape compile
#                  to no allocation and those a list keeps do (allocelide), and holders of objects
#                  keep their allocations and those objects through collections, with outputs
#                  matching CPython; and PYSTACHY_GC_MIN sets the allocation window between
#                  collections
#   unicode-audit  tools/unicode_audit.py: optional byte-boundary checks in JIT/AOT, cache
#                  reuse, ASCII/Unicode controls and GC-stress exception paths, both compilers;
#                  unicodeprobe checks code-point cache/locality, mutation and GC invalidation
#                  bytescanprobe checks bounded delimiter scans, guard pages and bulk-work counts
#                  floatprobe checks float-parser allocations and exact-terminator guard pages
#   scaling-0/-1   tools/scaling.py --check: both compilers compile its generated programs (500 and 1000
#                  functions, globals, classes, modules, chained imports, breaks, elifs, ...), and the
#                  lines the CPython-hosted compiler executes, and the items its builtin calls copy or
#                  scan, grow no faster than the programs; scaling-0 checks the shapes of SCALING_0 and
#                  scaling-1 every other one
# The shards of a suite (shard_cases: tests/corpus.sh's corpus_shard) are disjoint and together the
# whole corpus on every runner, balanced by the weights of tests/case_weights.txt, each heaviest
# first; tests-native, tests-opt-off and ubsan keep each case's time in build/verify/*-times.log,
# from which tools/case_weights.py makes that table.
# A step that runs tests/run.sh over the suite passes only with as many passes as the checks the suite
# holds, counted from its files (checks): a run that covered fewer cases fails.
# usage: tests/verify.sh [GROUP]   (make verify runs all)   env: PY (default python3), PYSTACHY_LLVM (LLVM 18 bin dir)
# CI may set VERIFY_BOOTSTRAP_DIR to a verified bundle from this run; local runs build afresh.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
. tests/corpus.sh
# shellcheck disable=SC3045 # (ulimit -c is not POSIX, but dash, bash, ksh and busybox have it)
ulimit -c 0 2> /dev/null  # (no core file of a crashing compiler or test program in the tree)
ROOT=$(pwd)
# PRs keep the complete native corpus in two JIT and four AOT workers and sample alternate configurations.
# Full verification remains the default for main, releases and local runs. The report gate binds
# this explicit profile and the independently reproduced sample; a PR report is never full evidence.
PROFILE=${VERIFY_PROFILE:-full}
case $PROFILE in
  full) NATIVE_SHARDS=3; CONFIG_SHARDS=3; PYTHON_FREE_SHARDS=4; UBSAN_SHARDS=5; OPTIN_SHARDS=3 ;;
  pr) NATIVE_SHARDS=2; CONFIG_SHARDS=1; PYTHON_FREE_SHARDS=1; UBSAN_SHARDS=1; OPTIN_SHARDS=1 ;;
  *) echo "verify: unknown profile: $PROFILE" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
# CI selects independent groups; a local run without arguments still runs every check.
# --list exposes the same plan to the final CI report gate, which rejects missing groups/steps.
plan() {
  if [ "$PROFILE" = pr ]; then
    case $1 in
      all) echo 'bootstrap tests-cpython tests-native-jit-0 tests-native-jit-1 tests-native-aot-0 tests-native-aot-1 tests-native-aot-2 tests-native-aot-3 tests-opt-off-0 runtime-cache python-free-0 ubsan-0 gc-self gc-jit-0 gc-aot-0 benchmarks example-cli dynany-optin-0 python-int-optin-0 annotation-widening check-ir runtime-table rtcheck re-fuzz dynany-fuzz re-probe rt-abi inherited-ast streaming ffi list-storage container-eq weakrefs box-slots file-buffers select-io dict-probes compile-limits jit-dead-code aot-dead-code unicode-audit scaling-0 scaling-1'; return ;;
      native-jit-[01]|native-aot-[012]) echo "bootstrap tests-$1"; return ;;
      native-aot-3) echo 'bootstrap tests-native-aot-3 scaling-1'; return ;;
      safety-0) echo 'bootstrap tests-opt-off-0 python-free-0 gc-jit-0'; return ;;
      safety-1) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-0 gc-aot-0'; return ;;
      opt-in) echo 'bootstrap dynany-optin-0 python-int-optin-0 annotation-widening'; return ;;
      cache-gc) echo 'bootstrap runtime-cache gc-self'; return ;;
      benchmarks) echo 'bootstrap benchmarks example-cli scaling-0'; return ;;
      bootstrap|hosted|contracts) ;; # shared names and steps below
      *) echo "verify: unknown PR group: $1" >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
  fi
  case $1 in
    bootstrap) echo 'bootstrap' ;;
    # (in the order a run of all records them: the contracts' steps, as their lanes report them, after
    # the opt-in sweeps)
    all) echo 'bootstrap tests-cpython tests-native-0 tests-native-1 tests-native-2 tests-opt-off-0 tests-opt-off-1 tests-opt-off-2 runtime-cache python-free-0 python-free-1 python-free-2 python-free-3 ubsan-0 ubsan-1 ubsan-2 ubsan-3 ubsan-4 gc-self gc-ir-0 gc-ir-1 gc-jit-0 gc-jit-1 gc-aot-0 gc-aot-1 gc-aot-2 benchmarks example-cli dynany-optin-0 dynany-optin-1 dynany-optin-2 python-int-optin-0 python-int-optin-1 python-int-optin-2 annotation-widening check-ir runtime-table rtcheck re-fuzz dynany-fuzz re-probe rt-abi inherited-ast streaming ffi list-storage container-eq weakrefs box-slots file-buffers select-io dict-probes compile-limits jit-dead-code aot-dead-code unicode-audit scaling-0 scaling-1' ;;
    hosted) echo 'bootstrap tests-cpython' ;;
    native-0) echo 'bootstrap tests-native-0' ;;
    native-1) echo 'bootstrap tests-native-1' ;;
    native-2) echo 'bootstrap tests-native-2' ;;
    native) echo 'bootstrap tests-native-0 tests-native-1 tests-native-2' ;; # local alias
    opt-off-0) echo 'bootstrap tests-opt-off-0' ;;
    opt-off-1) echo 'bootstrap tests-opt-off-1' ;;
    opt-off-2) echo 'bootstrap tests-opt-off-2' ;;
    opt-off) echo 'bootstrap tests-opt-off-0 tests-opt-off-1 tests-opt-off-2' ;; # local alias
    python-free-0) echo 'bootstrap python-free-0' ;;
    python-free-1) echo 'bootstrap python-free-1' ;;
    python-free-2) echo 'bootstrap python-free-2' ;;
    python-free-3) echo 'bootstrap python-free-3' ;;
    python-free) echo 'bootstrap python-free-0 python-free-1 python-free-2 python-free-3' ;; # local alias (one rebuild for the four quarters)
    ubsan-0) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-0' ;;
    ubsan-1) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-1' ;;
    ubsan-2) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-2' ;;
    ubsan-3) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-3' ;;
    ubsan-4) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-4' ;;
    ubsan) echo 'bootstrap ubsan-0 ubsan-1 ubsan-2 ubsan-3 ubsan-4' ;; # local alias (one sanitized build for the five fifths)
    gc-self) echo 'bootstrap gc-self' ;;
    gc-ir-0) echo 'bootstrap gc-ir-0' ;;
    gc-ir-1) echo 'bootstrap gc-ir-1' ;;
    gc-jit-0) echo 'bootstrap gc-jit-0' ;;
    gc-jit-1) echo 'bootstrap gc-jit-1' ;;
    gc-aot-0) echo 'bootstrap gc-aot-0' ;;
    gc-aot-1) echo 'bootstrap gc-aot-1' ;;
    gc-aot-2) echo 'bootstrap gc-aot-2' ;;
    gc-ir) echo 'bootstrap gc-ir-0 gc-ir-1' ;; # local aliases are not CI groups
    gc-jit) echo 'bootstrap gc-ir-0 gc-ir-1 gc-jit-0 gc-jit-1' ;;
    gc-aot) echo 'bootstrap gc-aot-0 gc-aot-1 gc-aot-2' ;;
    gc-stress) echo 'bootstrap gc-self gc-ir-0 gc-ir-1 gc-jit-0 gc-jit-1 gc-aot-0 gc-aot-1 gc-aot-2' ;;
    runtime-cache) echo 'bootstrap runtime-cache annotation-widening' ;;
    dynany-optin-0|dynany-optin-1|dynany-optin-2) echo "bootstrap $1" ;;
    dynany-optin) echo 'bootstrap dynany-optin-0 dynany-optin-1 dynany-optin-2' ;; # local alias
    python-int-optin-0|python-int-optin-1|python-int-optin-2) echo "bootstrap $1" ;;
    python-int-optin) echo 'bootstrap python-int-optin-0 python-int-optin-1 python-int-optin-2' ;; # local alias
    contracts) echo 'bootstrap check-ir runtime-table rtcheck re-fuzz dynany-fuzz re-probe rt-abi inherited-ast streaming ffi list-storage container-eq weakrefs box-slots file-buffers select-io dict-probes compile-limits jit-dead-code aot-dead-code unicode-audit' ;;
    benchmarks) echo 'bootstrap benchmarks example-cli' ;;
    scaling) echo 'bootstrap scaling-0 scaling-1' ;;
    *) echo "verify: unknown group: $1" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
[ $# -le 1 ] || { echo 'usage: tests/verify.sh [all|hosted|native-0|native-1|native-2|native|opt-off-0|opt-off-1|opt-off-2|opt-off|python-free-0|python-free-1|python-free-2|python-free-3|python-free|ubsan-0|ubsan-1|ubsan-2|ubsan-3|ubsan-4|ubsan|gc-self|gc-ir-0|gc-ir-1|gc-ir|gc-jit-0|gc-jit-1|gc-jit|gc-aot-0|gc-aot-1|gc-aot-2|gc-aot|gc-stress|runtime-cache|dynany-optin-0|dynany-optin-1|dynany-optin-2|dynany-optin|python-int-optin-0|python-int-optin-1|python-int-optin-2|python-int-optin|contracts|benchmarks|scaling|--list]' >&2; exit 2; }
GROUP=${1:-all}
if [ "$GROUP" = --list ]; then
  groups='all bootstrap hosted native-0 native-1 native-2 opt-off-0 opt-off-1 opt-off-2 python-free-0 python-free-1 python-free-2 python-free-3 ubsan-0 ubsan-1 ubsan-2 ubsan-3 ubsan-4 gc-self gc-ir-0 gc-ir-1 gc-jit-0 gc-jit-1 gc-aot-0 gc-aot-1 gc-aot-2 runtime-cache dynany-optin-0 dynany-optin-1 dynany-optin-2 python-int-optin-0 python-int-optin-1 python-int-optin-2 contracts benchmarks scaling'
  [ "$PROFILE" != pr ] || groups='all bootstrap hosted native-jit-0 native-jit-1 native-aot-0 native-aot-1 native-aot-2 native-aot-3 safety-0 safety-1 opt-in contracts cache-gc benchmarks'
  for g in $groups; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$g" "$(plan "$g")"
  done
  exit 0
fi
SELECTED=$(plan "$GROUP") || exit 2
# a test outside the corpus's areas would be in no step's count (tests/corpus.sh)
strays=$(corpus_strays)
[ -z "$strays" ] || { printf 'tests/verify.sh: no step tests these files, outside the corpus'"'"'s areas:\n%s\n' "$strays" >&2; exit 2; }
want() { case " $SELECTED " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac; }
expected=0
for x in $SELECTED; do expected=$((expected + 1)); done
PY=${PY:-python3}
# LLVM's checked 128-bit multiplication can call __muloti4 on ARM64. That builtin
# belongs to compiler-rt, not libgcc or the preloaded UBSan shared library.
UBSAN="-fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all --rtlib=compiler-rt"
V=$ROOT/build/verify
OUT=$ROOT/build/verification.json
rm -rf "$V" "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$V/home" "$V/ubsan-home"
if [ "$PROFILE" = pr ]; then
  # Fail closed before the bootstrap/build when a PR base is unavailable or the selection is empty.
  # The common sampler includes new/changed cases and representatives of every corpus area.
  $PY tools/ci_sample.py ${CI_BASE_SHA:+--base "$CI_BASE_SHA"} --manifest "$V/pr-selection.json" > "$V/pr-cases.log" || exit 2
  [ -s "$V/pr-cases.log" ] || { echo 'verify: empty PR sample' >&2; exit 2; }
  grep '^tests/programs/' "$V/pr-cases.log" > "$V/pr-programs.log"
  [ -s "$V/pr-programs.log" ] || { echo 'verify: empty PR program sample' >&2; exit 2; }
fi
cp runtime.c runtime.py lljit.c "$V/home/"
cp runtime.c runtime.py lljit.c "$V/ubsan-home/"
cp -R lib ryu mpz "$V/home/"
cp -R lib ryu mpz "$V/ubsan-home/"
export PYSTACHY_HOME="$ROOT"
# The steps set the knobs they test themselves: one left in the caller's environment would weaken a
# step (PYSTACHY_GC=off: gc-stress collects nothing) or fail it falsely (PYSTACHY_OPT=-all), so they
# are dropped, and the report lists them (PYSTACHY_LLVM and PYSTACHY_JOBS are kept)
ign=$(env | sed -nE 's/^(PYSTACHY_(PATH|CFLAGS|AOT_OPT|RUNTIME_C_CACHE|GC|GC_MIN|GC_STRESS|GC_STRESS_PROGRAM|IRCHECK|IRFX|TIMING|OPT|JIT_INLINE|JIT_CODEGEN|JIT_LAUNCHER|PROGRAM_CACHE|PROGRAM_CACHE_TRACE|PROGRAM_CACHE_INPUTS|PROGRAM_CACHE_LOCK|UNICODE_AUDIT|DEBUG_LINES|ARGV0|CASE_TIMES))=.*$/\1/p' | sort -u)
for e in $ign; do echo "verify: ignoring $e=$(printenv "$e")"; unset "$e"; done
LLVM=${PYSTACHY_LLVM:+${PYSTACHY_LLVM%/}/}

now() { date +%s.%N; }
secs() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.3f", b - a }'; }
js() { printf '"%s"' "$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')"; }
lines() { wc -l < "$1" | tr -d ' '; }
sha() { sha256sum "$1" | cut -c1-64; }
same() { cmp -s "$1" "$2" && echo true || echo false; }
start=$(now); nsteps=0; nfail=0
# step NAME pass|fail START LOG [JSON fields]: append one step to the report (in a lane of the
# contracts' steps, below, keep it in build/verify/lanes for the shell to append)
step() {
  t=$(secs "$3" "$(now)")
  rec=$(printf '    {"name": "%s", "result": "%s", "seconds": %s, "log": %s%s}' "$1" "$2" "$t" "$(js "${4#"$ROOT"/}")" "$5")
  if [ -n "${lane:-}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$rec" > "$V/lanes/$1.json" && printf '%s %s %s\n' "$2" "$t" "$4" > "$V/lanes/$1.result"
    return
  fi
  record "$1" "$2" "$t" "$4" "$rec"
}

# Self-compilation has its own full-CI runner; all/local runs can overlap earlier checks.
# The compact cache-gc group waits for both cache runs before starting GC self-compilation.
# Bound it separately from the CI job,
# leaving time to write/upload a failed report. timeout forwards TERM to its process group,
# including the compiler, so cancellation cannot leave the background self-compile running.
gcpid=
# jobtree PID...: those of the PIDs that are still this shell's children, and every process below them,
# from one listing of each process's parent (POSIX ps; without it, the PIDs alone)
jobtree() {
  { ps -A -o pid= -o ppid= 2> /dev/null || for p; do echo "$p $$"; done; } | awk -v shell=$$ -v roots="$*" '
    BEGIN { n = split(roots, r, " "); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) root[r[i]] = 1 }
    { parent[$1] = $2 }
    END {
      for (p in parent) if ((p in root) && parent[p] == shell) tree[p] = 1
      do { more = 0; for (p in parent) if (!(p in tree) && (parent[p] in tree)) { tree[p] = 1; more = 1 } } while (more)
      for (p in tree) print p
    }'
}
# stop_jobs PID...: end these background jobs and every process they started. TERM to a job alone
# would leave its programs running, and SIGINT reaches none of them (a background job of a shell
# without job control ignores it, as do the programs it runs), so each process of their trees is
# stopped while a listing finds one not yet stopped (a stopped process starts no other), then sent
# TERM and CONT; then the jobs are reaped.
stop_jobs() {
  stopped=" "
  while :; do
    new=$(jobtree "$@" | while read -r p; do case $stopped in (*" $p "*) ;; (*) printf '%s ' "$p" ;; esac; done)
    [ -n "$new" ] || break
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # (a list of PIDs)
    kill -STOP $new 2> /dev/null
    stopped="$stopped$new"
  done
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # (a list of PIDs)
  [ "$stopped" = " " ] || { kill -TERM $stopped; kill -CONT $stopped; } 2> /dev/null
  for p; do wait "$p" 2> /dev/null; done
}
# bgjobs: 1 where ps lists this shell's processes, as jobtree needs to find what a job started; without
# it the background jobs below (runtime-cache's native run, the contracts' runtime builds and lanes) run
# in the foreground instead, one after another, as every other step does, which a Ctrl-C reaches
bgjobs=
if ps -A -o pid= -o ppid= 2> /dev/null | awk -v shell=$$ '$1 == shell { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'; then
  bgjobs=1
else
  echo 'verify: ps lists no processes here: the steps that run side by side run one after another'
fi
cancel_gc() {
  if [ -n "$gcpid" ]; then
    kill "$gcpid" 2> /dev/null
    wait "$gcpid" 2> /dev/null
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # (lists of PIDs)
  stop_jobs ${warmpid:-} ${lanepids:-} ${cachepid:-}
  exit 130
}

  echo 'gc-self: starting (10-minute limit; build/verify/gc-self.log)'
  timeout --verbose --kill-after=10s 10m sh -c '
    started=$(date +%s)

    "$@" & child=$!

    wait "$child"

    # A signal interrupts wait; stay alive until the compiler exits so timeout can
    # escalate to KILL if it ignores TERM, and cancellation reaps it before returning.
    if [ "$status" -gt 128 ]; then wait "$child"; status=$?; fi
    echo "gc-self: finished after $(($(date +%s) - started))s, exit $status"

    "$V/pystachy2" ir pystachy.py -o "$V/stage-gc.ll" > "$V/gc-self.log" 2>&1 &

# ---- gc-self: fixed-point identity under compiler GC stress

  # after those lanes finish instead of competing with them as a third heavy process.

L=$V/gc-self-check.log; s=$(now); r=fail
{
  self_ok=0; self_status=127

    echo '-- waiting for bounded GC self-compile (exit 124 means timeout)'
    wait "$gcpid"; self_status=$?

  fi
  # Include the log on failure too: timeout/signal diagnostics must reach the step summary.
  cat "$V/gc-self.log"
  echo "gc-self: exit $self_status"

    cmp "$V/stage1.ll" "$V/stage-gc.ll" && echo "the compiler collecting every 5000 allocations emits the stage1 IR" &&
    r=pass

fi

# ---- GC stress: the stressed compiler's output, then the corpus in both modes, on independent CI runners
# gc-ir-0/-1: stage 2 collecting every GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL allocations must compile each case of one
# of two disjoint halves of the corpus (gc_shard_cases) exactly as stage 2 does unstressed (tools/irsame.sh:
# `ir`, or `rt` for rtmode_*, with the IR check on as tests/run.sh has it; the IR byte for byte, every
# message and the exit status), runtime.py too (`rt`), and `check` each syntax_*.py alike
# (tools/irsame.sh --check): the two halves compile every case once a run with the stressed compiler.
# The full gate requires both identity halves. Execution uses its own complete partition, balanced
# by native JIT/AOT weights: gc-jit-0/-1 (two halves, JIT) and gc-aot-0/-1/-2 (three thirds, AOT).
# Where the IR is the same, the LLVM tools build the same program, so they collect at every
# program allocation (PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM=1), compiled by stage 2 unstressed: compiling each case
# under stress again for each mode added nothing but time. A sample of each shard runs end to end with
# the compiler stressed too, so that the driver's paths after the IR run under stress: the runtime's
# build and cache (the sample runs first, in a cache of the GC steps' own that each run starts empty,
# so the stressed compiler builds the runtime every GC test of the run uses), opt and lli (JIT), clang
# and the link (AOT); the program-stressed run takes the shard's other cases, so each case runs exactly
# once in each mode.
# The sample is the cases at positions GC_JIT_SAMPLE_OFFSET (JIT) or GC_AOT_SAMPLE_OFFSET (AOT) modulo
# GC_SAMPLE_EVERY of the shard in weight order: drawn from the job's own shard, it stays there when
# the execution weights change, and is the same on every runner (integer weights, the C locale).
# Sampling positions does not guarantee a proportional share of work: the per-case timing logs
# expose the sample's actual cost. Offset 0 would put each shard's heaviest case in every sample;
# JIT's and AOT's offsets lie half a period apart, so that the modes, whose shards differ, stress
# different cases where their orders agree.
GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL=1000
GC_SAMPLE_EVERY=16
GC_JIT_SAMPLE_OFFSET=4
GC_AOT_SAMPLE_OFFSET=12
for shard in 0 1; do
  want gc-ir-$shard || continue
  L=$V/gc-ir-$shard.log; s=$(now); r=fail; ir_ok=false; ir_n=0; rt_ok=false; chk_ok=false
  gc_shard_cases $shard 2 "$V/gc-ir-$shard-cases.log"
  grep '/syntax_[^/]*\.py$' "$V/gc-ir-$shard-cases.log" > "$V/gc-ir-$shard-syntax.log"
  chk_n=$(lines "$V/gc-ir-$shard-syntax.log")
  set --
  while IFS= read -r f; do set -- "$@" "$f"; done < "$V/gc-ir-$shard-cases.log"
  cases=$#
  {
    # An empty shard must not silently invoke irsame's whole-corpus default.
    if [ "$cases" != 0 ]; then
      echo "== runtime.py: stage 2, then stage 2 collecting every $GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL allocations (tools/irsame.sh)"
      PYSTACHY_IRCHECK=1 PYSTACHY_CASE_TIMES="$V/gc-ir-$shard-runtime-times.log" \
        tools/irsame.sh "$V/pystachy2" "env PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS=$GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL $V/pystachy2" runtime.py \
        > "$V/gc-ir-$shard-rt.log" 2>&1
      st=$?; cat "$V/gc-ir-$shard-rt.log"
      [ $st = 0 ] && [ "$(tail -1 "$V/gc-ir-$shard-rt.log")" = '1 programs identical' ] && rt_ok=true
      echo "== IR, messages and exit status of $cases cases: stage 2, then stressed (tools/irsame.sh)"
      PYSTACHY_IRCHECK=1 PYSTACHY_CASE_TIMES="$V/gc-ir-$shard-times.log" \
        tools/irsame.sh "$V/pystachy2" "env PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS=$GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL $V/pystachy2" "$@" \
        > "$V/gc-ir-$shard-ir.log" 2>&1
      st=$?; cat "$V/gc-ir-$shard-ir.log"
      ir_n=$(tail -1 "$V/gc-ir-$shard-ir.log" | sed -n 's/^\([0-9]*\) programs identical$/\1/p')
      [ $st = 0 ] && [ "${ir_n:-0}" = "$cases" ] && ir_ok=true
      set --
      while IFS= read -r f; do set -- "$@" "$f"; done < "$V/gc-ir-$shard-syntax.log"
      if [ $# != 0 ]; then
        echo "== check of the $# syntax_*.py cases: stage 2, then stressed (tools/irsame.sh --check)"
        PYSTACHY_CASE_TIMES="$V/gc-ir-$shard-check-times.log" \
          tools/irsame.sh --check "$V/pystachy2" "env PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS=$GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL $V/pystachy2" "$@" \
          > "$V/gc-ir-$shard-check.log" 2>&1
        st=$?; cat "$V/gc-ir-$shard-check.log"
        n=$(tail -1 "$V/gc-ir-$shard-check.log" | sed -n 's/^\([0-9]*\) programs identical$/\1/p')
        [ $st = 0 ] && [ "${n:-0}" = "$chk_n" ] && chk_ok=true
      else
        echo 'no syntax_*.py case in this half'; chk_ok=true
      fi
    else
      echo 'empty GC identity shard'
    fi
  } > "$L" 2>&1
  [ $ir_ok = true ] && [ $rt_ok = true ] && [ $chk_ok = true ] && r=pass
  step gc-ir-$shard $r "$s" "$L" ", \"compiler_interval\": $GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL, \"reference\": \"stage2\", \"ir_cases\": ${ir_n:-0}, \"ir_identical\": $ir_ok, \"runtime_identical\": $rt_ok, \"check_cases\": $chk_n, \"check_identical\": $chk_ok, \"shard_index\": $shard, \"shard_count\": 2"
done
for gc_group in gc-jit-0 gc-jit-1 gc-aot-0 gc-aot-1 gc-aot-2; do
  want "$gc_group" || continue
  L=$V/$gc_group.log; s=$(now); r=fail; mode=jit; gc_shards=2; offset=$GC_JIT_SAMPLE_OFFSET; shard=${gc_group##*-}
  sample_ok=0; y=""
  case $gc_group in gc-aot-*) mode=aot; gc_shards=3; offset=$GC_AOT_SAMPLE_OFFSET ;; esac
  [ "$PROFILE" != pr ] || gc_shards=1
  configuration_cases "$shard" "$gc_shards" "$V/$gc_group-shard.log"
  shard_n=$(lines "$V/$gc_group-shard.log")
  # (in one pass over the shard, each case to exactly one of the two: the sample, or the others)
  : > "$V/$gc_group-sample-cases.log"
  awk -v every=$GC_SAMPLE_EVERY -v offset="$offset" -v sample="$V/$gc_group-sample-cases.log" \
    '(NR - 1) % every == offset { print > sample; next } { print }' "$V/$gc_group-shard.log" > "$V/$gc_group-cases.log"
  set --
  while IFS= read -r f; do set -- "$@" "$f"; done < "$V/$gc_group-sample-cases.log"
  sample_n=$#
  # Empty selections must not silently invoke run.sh's whole-suite default.
  if [ $# != 0 ]; then
    PYSTACHY_CACHE="$V/gc-cache" PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS=$GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM=1 \
      PYSTACHY_CASE_TIMES="$V/$gc_group-sample-times.log" \
      tests/run.sh "$V/pystachy2" "$mode" "$@" > "$V/$gc_group-sample.log" 2>&1 && sample_ok=1
    y=$(tests "$(checks "$mode" "$@")" "$V/$gc_group-sample.log" 2>> "$V/$gc_group-sample.log") || sample_ok=0
  else
    echo 'empty GC sample' > "$V/$gc_group-sample.log"
  fi
  { echo "== $mode, compiler and program GC-stressed: the $# cases at positions $offset modulo $GC_SAMPLE_EVERY of shard $shard of $gc_shards ($shard_n cases, heaviest first)"
    cat "$V/$gc_group-sample.log"; } > "$L"
  set --
  while IFS= read -r f; do set -- "$@" "$f"; done < "$V/$gc_group-cases.log"
  [ $# != 0 ] || { echo 'empty GC shard' >> "$L"; step "$gc_group" fail "$s" "$L" ""; continue; }
  echo "== $mode, program GC-stressed: the shard's other $# cases" >> "$L"
  PYSTACHY_CACHE="$V/gc-cache" PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM=1 PYSTACHY_CASE_TIMES="$V/$gc_group-suite-times.log" \
    tests/run.sh "$V/pystachy2" "$mode" "$@" > "$V/$gc_group-suite.log" 2>&1
  suite_status=$?
  cat "$V/$gc_group-suite.log" >> "$L"
  x=$(tests "$(checks "$mode" "$@")" "$V/$gc_group-suite.log" 2>> "$L") && [ "$suite_status" = 0 ] && [ $sample_ok = 1 ] && r=pass
  step "$gc_group" $r "$s" "$L" ", \"tests_interval\": 1, \"tests_compiler_interval\": 0, \"modes\": [\"$mode\"], \"shard_index\": $shard, \"shard_count\": $gc_shards, \"shard_cases\": $shard_n, \"cases\": $#$x, \"stressed_sample\": {\"every\": $GC_SAMPLE_EVERY, \"offset\": $offset, \"cases\": $sample_n, \"tests_interval\": 1, \"tests_compiler_interval\": $GC_COMPILER_INTERVAL$y}$(case_fields "$V/$gc_group-shard.log")"
done

# ---- benchmarks: same output as CPython, JIT and AOT
if want benchmarks; then
L=$V/benchmarks.log; s=$(now); r=pass; x=""; n=0; ok=0

for b in bench/*.py; do

    "${x:+,}" "$k" $i "$(secs "$t0" "$t1")" "$(secs "$t1" "$t2")" "$(secs "$t2" "$t3")" "$(secs "$t3" "$t4")")"
done
step benchmarks $r "$s" "$L" ", \"programs\": $n, \"identical\": $ok, \"timings\": [$x]"
fi
